parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that houses all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, supports the door, and encloses the microwave cavity to contain electromagnetic waves.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the microwave is made of tempered glass with a metal mesh layer for radiation shielding.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to access the cooking chamber, provides visibility inside, and ensures safety by blocking microwaves.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a hinge to open and close the microwave cavity.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of durable plastic and contains buttons or a dial interface.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to set cooking time, power level, and other functions of the microwave.
parts.Movement_description: The buttons or dials on the control panel can be pressed or rotated to input commands.
